title.en: Chapter 22 — The River Under the Mountain

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: وأنا قاعد جنب قبري، لاحظت إشي ما لاحظته قبل.
sentences.en: And as I sat beside my grave, I noticed something I had not noticed before.

sentences.ar: نهر زغير، حلو، بينزل من الجبل، وبيفوت بمغارة تحته.
sentences.en: A small river, sweet, coming down from the mountain, and going into a cave beneath it.
It goes in, and does not come out.
And I said: the river is going somewhere.
And somewhere is not here.

sentences.ar: يمكن يطلع بالجهة التانية من الجبل.
sentences.en: Perhaps it comes out on the other side of the mountain.
Perhaps it reaches a country with people.

sentences.ar: ويمكن يوصل للعتمة بس، وأموت جواته.
sentences.en: And perhaps it reaches only darkness, and I die inside it.
But here, I was certainly dead.

sentences.ar: عملت طوف زغير من خشب السفن.
sentences.en: I made a small raft from the wood of the ships.
Narrow, the width of the river, and as long as myself.

sentences.ar: وحملته باللي ضل من الأكل، وبأحسن اللي لقيته.
sentences.en: And I loaded it with what remained of the food, and the best of what I had found.
Pearls, ambergris, stones.
And I tied myself to it, and pushed it into the river.
And I entered the cave.
Darkness.

sentences.ar: الصخر فوقي، قريب لدرجة إنه بيحك راسي.
sentences.en: The rock above me, so close it scraped my head.
And only the sound of the water.

sentences.ar: تمددت على ظهري، والطوف بيمشي مع التيار.
sentences.en: I lay on my back, the raft moving with the current.
Hours, days, I do not know.

sentences.ar: وأكلت آخر خبزة، وشربت من النهر.
sentences.en: And I ate the last loaf, and drank from the river.
And I slept.

sentences.ar: نوم عميق، زي الموت، بس مش موت.
sentences.en: A deep sleep, like death, but not death.
And I woke to light, and voices.

sentences.ar: كنت على شط نهر، تحت الشمس.
sentences.en: I was on a riverbank, under the sun.

sentences.ar: وحوالي ناس، بيحكوا لغة ما بعرفها.
sentences.en: And around me people, speaking a language I did not know.
One of them spoke Arabic.
He said: who are you?
And where did you come from?
I said: from under the mountain.
They looked at each other, and did not believe.

sentences.ar: وحكيت لهم القصة، من السفينة للطوف.
sentences.en: And I told them the story, from the ship to the raft.
And they said: this is a marvel.
The king must hear it.
And I asked: which king?
And which country?
They said: Serendib.
